name: Kedouin Makoto
source:
A girl from a Firefolk family much like Izumi.

On orders to slay Light Hunters, she and Kirara traveled around fighting many battles, eventually finding themselves in Otsuna.

She and Ryou are classmates.

She has a well-honed physique and fights with martial arts.

Her ability is unknown.

Her weapons are gloves called Boltdrill Gloves.

(from Kagura Games' website)
